title: Ordinary Rust gate loses numeric counts when child test announcements interleave
outcome: The launcher records truthful ordinary Rust test counts or precise bounded uncertainty when nested child libtest output interleaves with the outer runner.
acceptance: A fixture reproducing nested child running-test announcements during an outer libtest runner is handled without incorrectly replacing the outer runner's announced count.
Ordinary Rust gate count attribution preserves native exit status and fails closed on genuinely incomplete or ambiguous summaries.
